links.outcome: Parameter-matching accuracy of GPT-4o versus human fitters on same cases
links.effect: GPT-4o 78% accuracy (196/250), comparable to human fitters (experienced ophthalmologist 83%, optometrists 85%, general ophthalmologists 76%); kappa 0.18-0.60.
links.quote: GPT-4o achieved 78% accuracy (196/250), comparable to human fitters (experienced ophthalmologist: 83%, optometrists: 85%, general ophthalmologists: 76%).

screen.reason: Retrospective study comparing the accuracy, speed, and cost of GPT-4o against human fitters for orthokeratology lens parameter selection without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
